answer: Long-vesting rewards starve sybil factories: every reward is escrowed and freed in 1% slices over 100 epochs. Step one: rewards lock in escrow. Step two: each close emits an unlock signal freeing 1%, tracked on a public vesting atlas. Step three: a slashed identity forfeits unvested tranches to the honest pool. Forging 1,000 identities locks 1,000 shares for 100 epochs; at 5% yearly cost the idle drain is ~25 epoch-equivalents, dwarfing quick payouts. An honest agent pays one walnut-sized cost for the full reward, while fakes turn sybil scale into a self-inflicted capital freeze.
